value.signature: fn enter_command_scope (& self , command_name : & str) -> Scope

exception.justification: Justified: This entry-origin adapter lends the existing root identity to a contextual span without creating another operation.

review.body: { let Some (operation) = self . operation . as_ref () else { return Scope (tracing :: Span :: none () . entered ()) ; } ; let ticket = RootHandoff { observation : Arc :: as_ptr (& operation . observation . next_id) as usize , root_id : operation . id , } ; let span = with_root_handoff (ticket , | | command_scope_span (command_name)) ; Scope (span . entered ()) }
review.item_premise: Current body preserves once-only origin transfer and level-independent accounting; release off creates no delivery machinery or closing publication.
